headline: US Escalates Tech War by Targeting China's 7nm Chip Production, Prompting Evasion Tactics.
summary: The US is tightening sanctions on advanced Chinese semiconductor manufacturing, specifically targeting Hua Hong's 7nm nodes, leading China to seek alternative partnerships with South Korean firms to bypass restrictions. This directly intensifies the global tech war, threatening semiconductor supply chain stability and pressuring international chipmakers to navigate complex geopolitical boundaries.
